findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no chlorine test kit for the facility. Provide a chlorine test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed no thermometers in refrigerator and freezers.  Provide thermometer and place in the warmest part of the cooler/freezer. Provide thermometers.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no Chlorine test kit for facility.  Provide a Chlorine test kit or purchase QUAT Ammonia concentration. Facility has QUAT test strips.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed a drawer holding clean utensils to have food debris.  The drawer was cleaned out during the inspection.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed forks and spoons intermixed in utensil holder.  Utensils were placed in a manner to protect from cross contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels at the handwashing sink in the kitchen.  Provide paper towels for employees or volunteers to dry hands after washing them.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110c: Absence of self-closing devices on the restroom doors and the ceiling tiles are not smooth and easily cleanable. At next remodel of facility, provide self-closing device on restroom doors and replace restroom ceiling tiles with smooth and easily cleanable tiles.
